question: Which of these is NOT an Endocrine Gland?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Salivary**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Salivary gland** is NOT an endocrine gland.
 
• Endocrine glands secrete hormones directly into the bloodstream, while **salivary glands** secrete saliva into the mouth.
 
• Examples of endocrine glands include the **Thyroid, Adrenal, and Pineal glands**, which release hormones that regulate various body functions.
 
• Salivary glands are part of the digestive system and play a crucial role in the initial stages of digestion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The human body has three pairs of major salivary glands: the **parotid glands, submandibular glands, and sublingual glands**.
 
• These glands produce saliva, which contains enzymes that begin the process of breaking down food.
 
• Endocrine glands, such as the **Thyroid and Adrenal glands**, play a vital role in regulating metabolism, stress response, and other essential bodily functions.
 
• The **Pineal gland** is responsible for producing melatonin, which regulates sleep patterns.
 
• Understanding the difference between endocrine and exocrine glands is fundamental in the study of human physiology and medicine.
